treaty.en: Potsdam Agreement (1945) / Treaty on the Final Settlement (1990)
treaty.zh: 波茨坦协定（1945）/ 对德最终解决条约（1990）

note.en: The northern part was placed under Soviet administration (today Russia's Kaliningrad Oblast); the southern part passed to Poland. The Oder–Neisse line was confirmed as Germany's eastern border by the 1990 Two-plus-Four Treaty.
note.zh: 北部划归苏联（今俄罗斯加里宁格勒州），南部划归波兰。奥得-尼斯河线作为德国东部边界，于1990年《对德最终解决条约》中最终确认。

sources.title: Treaty on the Final Settlement with Respect to Germany (Two-plus-Four Treaty), 1990

label.en: Military restrictions / rearmament of the Bundeswehr
label.zh: 军事限制 / 联邦国防军重建

note.en: Amid the Cold War, the Western powers permitted West Germany to rearm and join NATO in 1955, with the Bundeswehr established that year. West Germany renounced the manufacture of nuclear, biological, and chemical weapons under the 1954 Paris Agreements — a restriction still in force.
note.zh: 冷战背景下，西方于1955年允许西德重新武装并加入北约，联邦国防军同年成立。西德依据1954年《巴黎协定》放弃制造核生化武器，该项限制至今有效。

sources.title: Protocol No. III on the Control of Armaments (Western European Union, 1954)

note.en: Under the 1952 Luxembourg (Reparations) Agreement, West Germany paid Israel approximately 3 billion Deutsche Marks in goods and services, completed in 1965.
note.zh: 依据1952年《卢森堡协议》，西德以商品和服务形式向以色列支付约30亿马克，1965年完成。

sources.title: Luxembourg Agreement (Reparations Agreement between Israel and West Germany), 1952

note.en: In 1953 the Polish People's Republic declared it would waive further reparations from Germany; Germany regards the matter as legally closed. In 2022 Poland revived a claim of roughly 1.3 trillion US dollars, which Germany rejected. The dispute remains unresolved.
note.zh: 1953年波兰人民共和国声明放弃对德进一步索赔，德国视此问题在法律上已了结。2022年波兰重新提出约1.3万亿美元索赔，德国予以拒绝，争议至今未解决。

sources.title: Declaration of the Polish People's Republic on the waiver of reparations (1953)
Report on Poland's 2022 reparations demand and Germany's rejection

label.zh: 去纳粹化 / 纽伦堡审判

note.en: The main Nuremberg Trial of major war criminals concluded in 1946, but many lower- and mid-level Nazi officials were never prosecuted, and some were reinstated in West German institutions during the Cold War.
note.zh: 纽伦堡主要战犯审判于1946年结束，但大量中下层纳粹官员未受审判，冷战期间部分人员被西德机构重新启用。

sources.title: Charter of the International Military Tribunal (London Agreement), 1945
Judgment of the International Military Tribunal, Nuremberg, 1946
